objective: Meet Sensei Hisame in the Academy yard
title: The Graduation Trial
summary: Sensei Hisame puts you through the graduation trial.

lines: You're late, {name}. The sun is up, and so are the dummies.
The dummies weren't going anywhere, Sensei.
Neither are you, until you pass. Graduation trial. Three parts: tools, seals, and an opponent who hits back.
Tools first. A kunai that misses is a gift to your enemy. Hit a dummy. Twice.

beats.text: Hit a dummy with a kunai ({throw_tool})

lines: Good. Now the part they write songs about: hand seals.
Hold {weave}, make the seals, let go to cast. Tiger, then Ox. That's Ember Volley.

beats.text: Weave Tiger, Ox to cast Ember Volley (hold {weave})

lines: Fire burns wind. Wind cuts lightning. Lightning shatters earth. Earth dams water. Water drowns fire.
Learn the circle and every fight gets shorter. The dummy on the right is wind-natured. Show it some fire.

beats.text: Land a WEAK! hit: fire on the Wind dummy

lines: Last part. When something swings at you, don't be there. Or be ready.
This is the Scroll of Five Natures. The academy lends its chakra to make clones for training.
They hit back. They weave, too. Watch for seals above their heads: hit them first, and the jutsu dies in their hands.
One genin clone? I did three at once last spring.
Asahi. You're supposed to be on patrol.
Patrol's boring, and I wanted to see the new graduate. Not bad, {name}. Not good, either.
Tomorrow at noon. You and me, right here. Unless you're scared.
Wear something you don't mind getting singed.
Congratulations. You're a genin. Don't let him get in your head.
